"''Perhaps better than you.|Padmé Amidala and Moteé, to Anakin Skywalker|[[Age of Republic - Padmé Amidala 1|''Age of Republic - Padmé Amidala'' 1]]}} '''Moteé''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]]. She served as a member of the [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens]] protecting [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] during the final [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. ==Biography== The [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from [[Naboo]] eventually known as Moteé graduated from the [[political academy]] in [[Theed]] in [[22 BBY]].''[[Queen's Hope]]'' is set between the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] and the [[Battle of Christophsis]], both of which are dated to [[22 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. Moteé is stated to have recently graduated from [[Theed]]'s [[political academy]] in the novel, placing her graduation in that [[Standard year|year]]. In that [[Standard year|year]], shortly before the beginning of the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] had been the subject of an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination plot]]. In the first attempt on her life on [[Coruscant]], the Republic's [[capital]] [[planet]],{{Film|II}} [[Cordé]] and [[Versé]], two of Amidala's three [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaidens]], were [[Death|killed]]. In the search to recruit new handmaidens, Amidala and her remaining handmaiden, [[Dormé]], decided that the new recruits would serve more as traditional Senatorial [[aide]]s, and Dormé focused her search in that direction. While Amidala was privately recuperating on Naboo in the aftermath of the [[First Battle of Geonosis|Battle of Geonosis]], Dormé interviewed multiple candidates, eventually selecting two: [[Ellé|Elleen]], a former aide to [[Governor of Naboo]] [[Sio Bibble]], and Moteé. Upon accepting the position, Moteé and Elleen chose to follow the tradition established by their predecessors in Amidala's service by changing their names to match Amidala's given one, with Elleen becoming Ellé. During the conflict, Moteé discovered Amidala's relationship with [[Anakin Skywalker]], and disapproved of what she believed was an ill-advised move on the senator's part. She accompanied Amidala and Dormé on a diplomatic [[Mission to Clabron|mission]] to the planet [[Clabron]], but the group was ambushed upon arrival and Moteé was hit in the shoulder by a [[sniper]] bolt fired by the [[Frenk]] [[assassin]] [[Lis Mohles]]. They escaped inside the building, where Amidala was able to work out an agreement with [[Second Minister]] [[Tarmin]]. They then counter-ambushed the assassin, capturing her to resolve the incident and return to Coruscant. Moteé attended the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] meeting in which [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] announced that the Galactic Republic was to be [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganized]] as the [[Galactic Empire]]. ==Personality and traits== Moteé had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and fair skin. She was discreet, able to keep the secret of the relationship between Amidala and the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. ==Equipment== Moteé wore a short, hooded, [[Color|mauve]]-colored [[Cloak|cape]] over a purple pleated dress.''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' ==Behind the scenes== Moteé was played by the [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australian]] actress [[Kristy Wright]] in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]. The character's name was given in the film's closing credits. In the ''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'', the speech bubble with Palpatine's speech about the reorganization of the Galactic Republic into the Galactic Empire is directed towards her. This is most likely an error.''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' Unlike the other Naboo Royal Handmaidens who appear in [[E. K. Johnston]]'s Padmé trilogy—''[[Queen's Shadow]]'', ''[[Queen's Peril]]'', and ''[[Queen's Hope]]''—Moteé does not have her original name mentioned. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *''[[Queen's Hope]]'' {{Ab|Queen's Hope (audiobook)}} *[[Age of Republic - Padmé Amidala 1|''Age of Republic - Padmé Amidala'' 1]] *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{SW|url=news/a-guide-to-the-royal-handmaidens|text=A Guide to the Royal Handmaidens of Naboo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Moteé |ja=モーテイ |ka=მოტი }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Galactic Republic individuals]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Naboo]] [[Category:Naboo Royal Handmaidens]]
